title: Have consistent promise practices for `async/await` and `then/catch`
description:
There is an odd mix of `async/await` and `then/catch` in this repository. 

This makes asynchronous flow hard to follow and causes inconsistent error handling.

title: Use @npmcli/package-json for prebuild version generation
description:
## Summary

Replace the inline prebuild script in package.json with a proper script using `@npmcli/package-json`.

## Context

From PR #45 review feedback: https://github.com/rstudio/rsconnect-ts/pull/45#discussion_r2712883140

The current inline script:
```json
"prebuild": "node -e \"const p=require('./package.json'); const fs=require('fs'); fs.writeFileSync('src/Version.ts', '// WARNING: this file is generated\\nexport const Version = \\\"' + p.version + '\\\"\\n')\""
```

Should be replaced with a cleaner approach using the standard `@npmcli/package-json` package:

```js
const PackageJson = require('@npmcli/package-json')
const pkg = await PackageJson.load(path)
pkg["version"]
// 1.0.0
```

## Tasks

- [ ] Add `@npmcli/package-json` as a dev dependency
- [ ] Create a `scripts/generate-version.js` script
- [ ] Update `prebuild` in package.json to use the new script

title: Add basic integration tests using `with-connect`
description:
Use https://github.com/posit-dev/with-connect to add tests that cover the functions used by `rstudio/actions`, the only consumer we know of for this library: 

  - APIClient.serverSettings()
  - Deployer.deployManifest()
  - EnvironmentUpdater.updateAppEnvironment()
  - ClientTaskPoller.poll()
  - ApplicationPather.strictAppPath()

https://github.com/posit-dev/with-connect/issues/27 links to several other PRs that have added tests with it.

title: Use v1 APIs
description: https://github.com/posit-dev/rsconnect-python/pull/731 and https://github.com/rstudio/rsconnect/pull/1280 can be references. The new APIs are mostly drop-in replacements but there are a couple of naming differences.

title: use /v1/tasks/{id} for task polling
description:
Use `GET /__api__/v1/tasks/{id}` to track task progress.

https://github.com/rstudio/rsconnect-ts/blob/f272cffb99e21151eee93e783ab7484b2eb10e9d/src/APIClient.ts#L158-L165

Documentation:

* https://docs.posit.co/connect/api/#get-/v1/tasks/-id-

title: use v1/content/{guid}/environment to modify environment variables
description:
Use `GET /__api__/v1/content/{guid}/environment` to obtain the names of configured environment variables.

https://github.com/rstudio/rsconnect-ts/blob/f272cffb99e21151eee93e783ab7484b2eb10e9d/src/APIClient.ts#L142-L149

This returns a list of environment variable names.

Use `PUT /__api__/v1/content/{guid}/environment` to overwrite all environment variables or `PATCH /__api__/v1/content/{guid}/environment` to modify a subset of variables.

https://github.com/rstudio/rsconnect-ts/blob/f272cffb99e21151eee93e783ab7484b2eb10e9d/src/APIClient.ts#L151-L156

This accepts a list of objects indicating the variable name and its value. 

Documentation references:

* https://docs.posit.co/connect/api/#get-/v1/content/-guid-/environment
* https://docs.posit.co/connect/api/#put-/v1/content/-guid-/environment
* https://docs.posit.co/connect/api/#patch-/v1/content/-guid-/environment

title: use public vanity API
description:
https://github.com/rstudio/rsconnect-ts/blob/0724ec28721a935e449638005578138804527489/src/APIClient.ts#L114-L119

The public `PUT /__api__/v1/content/{guid}/vanity` API has been available since Connect 1.8.6 (released in late 2020), which means that all supported versions of Connect have this API.

Update the API client to use the public vanity API.

Connect plans to remove this API in an upcoming release.

title: Adapt to axios@^1.6.6
description: The version of `axios` currently in the package dependencies has vulnerabilities marked by `npm audit` that require an `npm audit fix --force` to `axios@^1.6.6`, which is incompatible with the current usage of the library.

title: Task polling doesn't work on clustered RStudio Connect
description: A given task lives in memory on a specific node. This means that when interacting with a clustered RStudio Connect, the client _must include cookies_ so that the load balancer understands how to route the request.
